title: Phonic S2S
description: Shortcut for 'llm' with vendor automatically set to 'phonic'. Connects the caller to Phonic, a speech-to-speech model, for real-time voice conversation. Phonic finds the end of each turn itself. llmOptions.config is Phonic's config message (system_prompt, voice_id, welcome_message, agent, tools, ...); jambonz sets the audio formats. With no 'auth', jambonz uses the account's Phonic (phonic_s2s) speech-to-speech credential chosen by 'label'.

vendor.description: The LLM vendor (always 'phonic' for this shortcut).

model.description: The Phonic model, e.g. 'phonic-1'. Omit it for Phonic's current default. llmOptions.config.model wins when both are set.

auth.description: Optional. A Phonic API key. When omitted, jambonz uses the account's phonic_s2s credential chosen by 'label'.

apiKey.description: Phonic API key (starts with ph_), sent as a Bearer header.

connectOptions.description: Connection options, for a Phonic endpoint other than Phonic's cloud.

host.description: The Phonic host. Defaults to api.phonic.ai.

path.description: The websocket path. Defaults to v1/sts/ws.

llmOptions.description: config configures the conversation; dtmf passes the caller's keypad entries to the agent.

config.description: Phonic's config message, sent as given when the session opens. jambonz adds the MCP, handoff and hangup tools when they are configured, sets external_id to the call sid unless you set one, and sets input_format and output_format itself.

agent.description: A Phonic agent, by name, whose settings the conversation starts from.

project.description: The Phonic project the agent belongs to. Defaults to main.

welcome_message.description: What the agent says first. Without one (and without generate_welcome_message) Phonic waits for the caller.

generate_welcome_message.description: Let the agent write its own opening line.

tools.description: Tools by name (pre-defined or built-in, e.g. keypad_input, natural_conversation_ending), built-in tool objects, or inline tools {type: 'custom_websocket', tool_schema: {type: 'function', function: {name, description, parameters, strict: true}}}. Inline tool calls go to the toolHook.

default_language.description: ISO 639-1 language code. Defaults to en.

dtmf.description: Gather-style keypad options. When enable is true, each completed entry reaches the agent as the caller's message.

config.system_prompt: You answer the phone for Juniper Cafe. Be brief.
config.welcome_message: Juniper Cafe, how can I help?
